_meta.description: High-resolution micro-step funnels for business scenarios

saas_builder.name: SaaS Builder
saas_builder.description: Build a SaaS product from idea to $1M ARR — the full indie/startup path with real survival rates at each stage
saas_builder.entry_point: Person identifies a recurring problem they or others face and considers building software to solve it

stages.label: Notice a problem that could be solved with software
Identify a real, recurring problem worth solving
Talk to 10+ potential users and confirm they have the problem
Commit to actually building (not just researching)
Start building MVP — first lines of code
Survive 30 days of building without quitting
Launch publicly (Product Hunt, HN, Twitter, Reddit)
Get first 10 free signups from strangers
Collect feedback and iterate on MVP based on real usage
Convert one person to a paying customer
Identify and fix early churn (5-7% monthly is typical)
Find one repeatable growth channel (SEO, content, paid, referral)
stages.source: First Round Capital State of Startups 2024

saas_builder.end_to_end_conversion: 0.7% — of 1,000 people who identify a SaaS idea, roughly 7 reach $1M ARR within 5 years. Median time to $1M ARR is 5 years (ChartMogul 2025). Only 13.4% of launched SaaS products reach $1M ARR in 3 years.
sources: First Round Capital State of Startups 2024

local_business.name: Local Business (Restaurant/Shop/Cafe)
local_business.description: Open a physical local business from dream to multi-location — restaurants, cafes, shops, salons with real BLS survival data
local_business.entry_point: Person dreams of opening their own restaurant, cafe, or retail shop and begins exploring the idea seriously

stages.label: Dream about opening a business (talk about it, Pinterest boards, etc.)
Research the local market, competitors, foot traffic, demographics
Create a written business plan with financial projections
Secure funding (savings, loan, investors, family) — avg $50K-$250K
Find a suitable location (foot traffic, rent, size, zoning)
Obtain all required permits, licenses, health inspections
Soft opening — friends, family, test runs
Grand opening day — doors open to public
Survive month 1 — cash flow crunch, operational chaos
Build a base of regular/repeat customers
Survive year 1 (83% of all businesses do)
Reach monthly breakeven (revenue covers all costs)
Survive year 3 (65% of all businesses do)
Become consistently profitable (net positive after owner salary)
Survive year 5 (51% of all businesses do)
Systemize operations (SOPs, management layer, not owner-dependent)

local_business.end_to_end_conversion: 2.1% — of 1,000 people who dream of opening a local business, roughly 21 end up with a profitable, systemized business at year 5. For restaurants specifically, 60% fail in year 1 (National Restaurant Association), making food service the hardest vertical.

partnership_business.name: Partnership Business (Start with a Friend/Co-founder)
partnership_business.description: Start a business with a partner — from exciting idea to either scaling together or painful breakup, with Harvard data on co-founder conflict
partnership_business.entry_point: Two friends or colleagues have a business idea together and get excited about building it

stages.label: Have a friend/acquaintance with shared interest
Have a business idea with a friend — mutual excitement
Sit down and discuss it seriously (not just bar talk)
Agree on who does what (roles and responsibilities)
Agree on equity split (50/50 is most common and most dangerous)
Actually formalize with LLC/contract/operating agreement
stages.source: Wasserman — 80% of partnerships lack written agreements

stages.label: Both invest first money (savings, equipment, time off work)
Build together for first month — honeymoon phase
Continue building for 3 months — reality sets in
First real disagreement (strategy, effort, direction, money)
Successfully resolve the disagreement without resentment
Have the hard money conversation (who gets paid what, reinvest vs distribute)
Navigate effort imbalance (one partner working more than the other)
Major conflict point (pivot, money, new partner, exit, life changes)
stages.source: Wasserman — 65% fail due to co-founder conflict

stages.label: Both partners choose to continue (no exit)
Restructure roles and equity based on actual contribution
Scale the business together past $500K revenue
Partnership intact and thriving at year 3

partnership_business.end_to_end_conversion: 1.8% — of 1,000 pairs who get excited about a business idea together, roughly 18 end up with a thriving partnership at year 3. 65% of startups fail due to co-founder conflict (Wasserman, Harvard). The #1 killer is unequal effort + 50/50 equity.
sources: Noam Wasserman — The Founder's Dilemmas (Harvard Business School) 2012
First Round Capital State of Startups Review 2024

affiliate_marketing.name: Affiliate Marketing (Blog/SEO/Content)
affiliate_marketing.description: Build an affiliate marketing business through content and SEO — from picking a niche to earning $10K/month, with brutal conversion reality
affiliate_marketing.entry_point: Person learns about affiliate marketing (YouTube, course, blog post) and decides to try it as a side income

stages.label: Learn about affiliate marketing (watch videos, read guides)
Pick a niche (often too broad or too competitive first time)
Buy domain and hosting, set up WordPress/blog
Learn SEO fundamentals (keyword research, on-page, link building)
Reach 30 published articles with keyword targeting
Wait for Google indexing and ranking (the sandbox period)
stages.source: Ahrefs Study: 95% of pages get zero Google traffic in first year 2024

stages.label: Get first consistent organic traffic (100+ visits/month)
stages.source: Ahrefs — 5.7% of pages rank in top 10 within 1 year 2024

stages.label: Apply to affiliate programs (Amazon, ShareASale, niche programs)
Get accepted to relevant affiliate programs
Get first affiliate link clicks from organic traffic
Diversify across multiple affiliate programs and networks
Build email list (1,000+ subscribers) for direct monetization
Reach $10,000/month (top 1% of affiliates)
stages.source: Authority Hacker — top 10% earn 90% of all affiliate income 2024

affiliate_marketing.end_to_end_conversion: 0.3% — of 1,000 people who start learning affiliate marketing, roughly 3 reach $10K/month. 95% of affiliates earn less than $1K/month. The top 10% earn 90% of all affiliate income. Average time to first sale: 6-12 months. 95% of new pages get zero Google traffic in the first year.
sources: Authority Hacker Annual Affiliate Marketing Survey 2024

newsletter_media.name: Newsletter/Media Business
newsletter_media.description: Build a newsletter or media business from scratch to $10K/month — through consistent publishing, audience building, and monetization
newsletter_media.entry_point: Person decides to start a newsletter on a topic they know or care about, often inspired by successful newsletter creators

stages.label: Choose a topic/niche for the newsletter
Set up on Substack, Beehiiv, ConvertKit, or Ghost
Share with friends, social media, existing network
Publish consistently for 1 month (4 issues)
stages.source: Substack — 90% of newsletters go inactive within 6 months 2024

stages.label: Maintain weekly publishing for 3 months (12+ issues)
Find your unique voice/angle that differentiates from others
Implement growth tactics (cross-promos, referral programs, SEO)
Receive first sponsorship inquiry
stages.source: Sponsorship rates start at 1K-2K subs (Newsletter Operator 2024)

stages.label: Close first paid sponsorship deal ($25-$50 CPM)

newsletter_media.end_to_end_conversion: 0.5% — of 1,000 people who start a newsletter, roughly 5 reach $10K/month. 90% of newsletters go inactive within 6 months. 90% never reach 1,000 subscribers. Average open rate is 43% but click rate only 2%. The newsletter business is a consistency game — most people quit before the compounding kicks in.

subscription_box.name: Subscription Box -> Launch -> Scale
subscription_box.description: Person creates a niche subscription box (snacks, beauty, books, hobby items). Curates products, ships monthly. High churn model.
subscription_box.entry_point: Decides to create a subscription box

stages.label: Retain 70%+ subscribers for month 2
stages.source: Recurly 2024 — avg sub box churn 10-15% monthly

stages.label: Achieve positive unit economics per box
stages.source: Cratejoy 2024 — COGS + shipping often exceed price initially

subscription_box.reality_check: Subscription box churn is 10-15% monthly. That means you lose half your subscribers every 6 months. COGS + shipping is typically 60-70% of revenue. Most boxes fail because they can't acquire subscribers cheaper than the LTV.

real_estate_wholesaling.name: Real Estate Wholesaling -> Deals -> Income
real_estate_wholesaling.description: Person finds distressed properties, puts them under contract, and assigns the contract to an investor for a fee. No capital needed but requires hustle.

stages.label: Understand purchase agreements and assignment contracts
stages.source: BiggerPockets 2024 — 30% never learn the legal side

stages.label: Build cash buyer list (10+ investors)
stages.source: BiggerPockets 2024 — most skip this critical step

stages.label: Start marketing for deals (driving, direct mail, cold call)
Analyze first potential deal (ARV, repairs, offer)
Make first offer to seller
stages.source: BiggerPockets 2024 — fear of making offers is common

stages.label: Find cash buyer for the deal
Close first wholesale deal (earn assignment fee)
Transition to fix-and-flip with own capital

real_estate_wholesaling.reality_check: 90% of people who learn wholesaling never close a deal. The average wholesaler quits after 3 months. Marketing costs $500-5000/month. Many states now require a real estate license to wholesale.

event_planning.name: Event Planning Business -> Clients -> Growth
event_planning.description: Person starts an event planning business for weddings, corporate events, or parties. Service-based, relationship-driven, seasonal.
event_planning.entry_point: Decides to become an event planner

stages.label: Get event planning certification (optional)
stages.source: ILEA 2024 — certification not required but helps

event_planning.reality_check: Event planning is feast or famine. Wedding season is May-October. Corporate events cluster in Q4. Most planners work 60+ hour weeks during events. Margins are 15-20% after all costs.

pet_business.name: Pet Business -> Growth -> Scale
pet_business.description: Person starts a pet-related business: dog walking, pet sitting, grooming, or pet products. Fast-growing industry with strong demand.
pet_business.entry_point: Decides to start a pet business

stages.label: Get relevant certifications (pet first aid, grooming)
Get first pet client
stages.source: Rover 2024 — platforms give new sitters visibility boost

pet_business.reality_check: Pet industry is booming ($150B US) but pet care services have low margins. Dog walkers earn $15-25/walk, need 15-20 walks/day for good income. Liability insurance is critical — one dog bite lawsuit can end the business.

bookkeeping_service.name: Virtual Bookkeeping -> Clients -> Scale
bookkeeping_service.description: Person starts a virtual bookkeeping service for small businesses. Recurring revenue model, high demand, can be done remotely.
bookkeeping_service.entry_point: Decides to start a bookkeeping business

stages.label: Define pricing ($300-1500/month per client)
stages.source: Intuit 2024 — avg bookkeeper charges $500/month per small biz

bookkeeping_service.reality_check: Bookkeeping is one of the best recurring revenue service businesses. Once you have a client, retention is 90%+. But the first 5 clients are the hardest to get. Competition from offshore bookkeepers is increasing.

photography_business.name: Photography Business -> Bookings -> Growth
photography_business.description: Person turns photography skills into a business: weddings, portraits, events, commercial. High skill requirement, competitive market.
photography_business.entry_point: Decides to start a photography business

stages.label: Deliver edited photos to first client
Book first wedding (if wedding photographer)
stages.source: PPA 2024 — weddings are highest revenue per event

photography_business.reality_check: Average photographer earns $38K/year. Wedding photography is the most lucrative niche but also the most competitive. Gear depreciation, editing time, and marketing eat into margins. The market is saturated with hobbyists willing to work for cheap.

fitness_personal_training.name: Personal Trainer -> Clients -> Business
fitness_personal_training.description: Person becomes a certified personal trainer, gets clients at gym or independently, builds a fitness business. Can scale online.
fitness_personal_training.entry_point: Decides to become a personal trainer

stages.label: Get hired at gym or rent space
Launch online coaching/programming
stages.source: IHRSA 2024 — online allows scaling beyond hours

fitness_personal_training.reality_check: Average personal trainer earns $40K/year. PT certification costs $500-2000. Gym trainers keep only 40-50% of session fees. Client retention averages 6 months. Physical burnout is common after 5+ years.

social_media_management.name: Social Media Manager -> Clients -> Agency
social_media_management.description: Person offers social media management services to businesses. Creates content, manages accounts, runs ads. Can scale to agency.
social_media_management.entry_point: Decides to offer social media management

stages.label: Offer free social media audit to get meetings
Successfully manage first month of content
Demonstrate measurable results to client
stages.source: Sprout Social 2024 — social results take time

stages.label: Add paid advertising (Facebook/Google Ads) to services
stages.source: Sprout Social 2024 — ads increase value per client

stages.label: Reach $50,000 MRR ($600K ARR)
stages.source: Sprout Social 2024 — top 2% of SMM businesses

social_media_management.reality_check: Social media management is one of the most common freelance services. Competition is fierce. Clients expect results in 30 days but organic social takes 6+ months. Client churn is high because ROI is hard to prove.

laundromat_business.name: Laundromat -> Operations -> Cash Flow
laundromat_business.description: Person buys or builds a laundromat. Cash-heavy, semi-passive business with high upfront cost but steady income. Popular on social media as passive income play.
laundromat_business.entry_point: Decides to invest in a laundromat

stages.label: Secure financing ($100K-500K)
stages.source: Coin Laundry Association 2024 — high capital barrier

stages.label: Find location or buy existing laundromat

laundromat_business.reality_check: Laundromats are NOT passive income. Machines break, plumbing fails, coins get jammed, and homeless people use the space. Average laundromat nets $15-30K/year profit. Location is 90% of success.

music_production.name: Music Producer -> Beats -> Revenue
music_production.description: Person becomes a music producer, sells beats online, licenses music, or produces for artists. Can earn from BeatStars, YouTube, and sync licensing.
music_production.entry_point: Decides to become a music producer

stages.label: Earn $1,000/month from music
stages.source: BeatStars 2024 — top 5% of producers on platform

music_production.reality_check: There are 4M+ producers on BeatStars. Average lease sells for $30. You need to sell 100+ leases/month for meaningful income. 95% of producers on the platform earn under $100/month.

copywriting_freelance.name: Freelance Copywriter -> Clients -> High Income
copywriting_freelance.description: Person learns copywriting and offers services to businesses. Direct response, email, web copy, ads. One of the highest-paid freelance skills.
copywriting_freelance.entry_point: Decides to become a freelance copywriter

stages.label: Build swipe file of successful copy
Start cold outreach to potential clients
stages.source: AWAI 2024 — fear of outreach is biggest blocker

stages.label: Deliver first project with measurable results
Specialize in high-value niche (finance, SaaS, health)

copywriting_freelance.reality_check: Copywriting is one of the highest-paid freelance skills, but 90% of copywriters earn under $50K/year. The difference is specialization and direct response skills. AI is disrupting low-end copywriting — high-value strategic copy is still in demand.

rental_property.name: Rental Property Investor -> Cash Flow -> Portfolio
rental_property.description: Person buys rental property for passive income through cash flow and appreciation. Traditional wealth building path.
rental_property.entry_point: Decides to invest in rental property

stages.label: Analyze rental markets for cash flow
Get offer accepted
stages.source: NAR 2024 — competitive markets mean many rejections

stages.label: Achieve positive monthly cash flow
stages.source: BiggerPockets 2024 — not all properties cash flow after expenses

rental_property.reality_check: Average landlord spends 4 hours/week per property on management. 50% of landlords report tenant issues. Maintenance costs eat 1-3% of property value annually. Most rental properties barely break even after all expenses.

tutoring_online.name: Online Tutoring -> Students -> Income
tutoring_online.description: Person offers tutoring services online through platforms or independently. Math, science, languages, test prep. Low startup cost, flexible schedule.
tutoring_online.entry_point: Decides to become an online tutor

stages.label: Join tutoring platforms (Wyzant, Tutor.com, Varsity Tutors)
Get first student
stages.source: Wyzant 2024 — platform gives new tutors some visibility

stages.label: Launch group tutoring classes
stages.source: Wyzant 2024 — leverage for higher hourly earnings

tutoring_online.reality_check: Online tutoring is capped by available hours. At $50/hour and 20 hours/week, max income is $4,000/month before platform fees. Scaling requires group classes or courses. Competition from AI tutoring tools is increasing.

web_design_freelance.name: Freelance Web Designer -> Clients -> Agency
web_design_freelance.description: Person learns web design (WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace) and offers website design services to small businesses. One of the most common freelance paths.
web_design_freelance.entry_point: Decides to freelance as a web designer

stages.label: Get first paid web design project
Earn $3,000/month from web design
stages.source: Dribbble 2024 — avg freelance web designer earns $2-4K/month

stages.label: Hire developer to build while you sell/design

web_design_freelance.reality_check: Web design is one of the most commoditized freelance services. Squarespace, Wix, and AI website builders are reducing demand. Average project fee is $3-10K for small business sites. The real money is in monthly retainers and maintenance plans.

ai_automation_agency.name: AI Automation Agency -> Clients -> Scale
ai_automation_agency.description: Person offers AI automation services to businesses: chatbots, workflow automation, AI integrations. Fastest-growing agency niche in 2024-2025.
ai_automation_agency.entry_point: Decides to start an AI automation agency

stages.label: Learn AI tools (ChatGPT API, n8n, Make, Zapier)
Create case study with ROI metrics

ai_automation_agency.reality_check: AI automation is the hottest agency niche but competition is growing fast. Most businesses don't yet understand what AI can do for them — you're selling education as much as service. Average project is $2-5K.

property_management.name: Property Management Company -> Doors -> Scale
property_management.description: Person starts a property management company managing rentals for landlords. Earns 8-12% of rent per door. Scalable service business.
property_management.entry_point: Decides to start a property management company

stages.label: Define service tiers and pricing (8-12% of rent)

property_management.reality_check: Property management is a grind. You need 50+ doors to earn a full-time income. Tenants call at 2AM. Landlords blame you for everything. But it's one of the most recession-proof businesses.

handyman_service.name: Handyman Service -> Clients -> Business
handyman_service.description: Person starts a handyman/home repair service. High demand, low startup cost, can specialize or generalize.
handyman_service.entry_point: Decides to start a handyman business

stages.label: Specialize in high-value niche (plumbing, electrical, remodeling)

handyman_service.reality_check: Handyman work is physically demanding and income stops when you stop working. Average handyman charges $50-75/hour but utilization is 60-70% of available time. Weather and seasonality affect income. Scaling beyond yourself requires licensing.

print_on_demand_expanded.name: Print on Demand (Merch, Mugs, Art) -> Sales -> Scale
print_on_demand_expanded.description: Person creates designs and sells them on print-on-demand platforms like Redbubble, Merch by Amazon, Printful, TeeSpring. Zero inventory, zero upfront cost.

stages.label: Choose POD platform (Redbubble, Merch by Amazon, Printful)
Make first sale
stages.source: Redbubble 2024 -- 75% of shops never make a sale

stages.label: Build own Shopify store with Printful

print_on_demand_expanded.reality_check: POD margins are slim ($2-5 per sale typically). You need thousands of designs and/or viral niches to make real money. Most POD sellers earn less than $100/year. AI-generated designs are flooding every platform.

forex_trading.name: Forex Trading -> Consistency -> Income
forex_trading.description: Person starts trading forex (foreign exchange) with leverage. Extremely high failure rate. Most accessible but most dangerous trading market.

stages.label: Deposit first funds ($100-5000)
stages.source: FCA 2024 -- avg first deposit varies widely

stages.label: Practice on demo account
stages.source: FCA 2024 -- 60% skip demo and trade live immediately

stages.label: Have first profitable trading day
stages.source: Statistical -- random chance produces some wins

stages.label: Experience first margin call / blow account partially
Be net profitable for 3 consecutive months
Be net profitable for full year
stages.source: FCA 2024 -- 74-89% of retail forex accounts lose money

forex_trading.reality_check: FCA, ESMA, and AMF data show 74-89% of retail forex accounts lose money. Average retail forex trader loses everything within 6 months. Leverage is the silent killer -- 100x leverage means 1% move wipes you out.

ecommerce_shopify.name: Shopify Store -> Traffic -> Revenue
ecommerce_shopify.description: Person builds a Shopify store selling products (own brand or white label). Drives traffic through paid ads, SEO, and social media.

stages.label: Launch first Facebook/Instagram ad campaign
stages.source: Shopify 2024 -- paid ads are primary traffic source

stages.label: Achieve positive ROAS on ads
stages.source: Shopify 2024 -- most stores lose money on initial ads

stages.label: Net profitable after all costs including ads

ecommerce_shopify.reality_check: Average Shopify store conversion rate is 1.4%. Most stores fail because customer acquisition cost exceeds profit margin. Facebook ads average $1.72 CPC. You need $500-5000/month ad budget minimum to test.

storage_unit_business.name: Self-Storage Investment -> Cash Flow
storage_unit_business.description: Person invests in self-storage facility. High demand, low maintenance, strong cash flow. One of the best-performing commercial real estate sectors.

stages.label: Find facility to buy or land to build
Acquire existing or build new facility
Achieve positive cash flow after debt service

storage_unit_business.reality_check: Self-storage is the best-performing REIT sector over 25 years, but requires massive capital. Average facility costs $2M+. Stabilization takes 2-3 years. Competition from Public Storage, Extra Space, CubeSmart is intense.

medical_practice.name: Medical Practice -> Patients -> Growth
medical_practice.description: Doctor or dentist opens independent medical/dental practice. High revenue but high overhead. Ultimate credentialed service business.
medical_practice.entry_point: Licensed healthcare professional decides to open practice

stages.label: Create business plan and choose specialty
Secure financing ($100K-500K)
stages.source: AMA 2024 -- bank loans available for physicians

stages.label: Purchase equipment and set up office

medical_practice.reality_check: Average physician practice owner earns $300K but works 50+ hours/week and carries $200K+ in student debt. Overhead is 50-65% of revenue. Insurance reimbursement rates are declining. Administrative burden causes 50% burnout rate.

mobile_detailing.name: Mobile Detailing -> Bookings -> Fleet
mobile_detailing.description: Person starts mobile car/boat detailing business. Low startup cost, high margins, can scale with employees. Popular first business.

stages.label: Create social media presence with before/after photos

mobile_detailing.reality_check: Detailing has great margins (60-80%) but is physically demanding. Weather affects scheduling. Each detail takes 2-5 hours. Without employees, you're capped at $6-10K/month. Ceramic coating is the key to higher average tickets.

digital_course_platform.name: Online Course Creator -> Launch -> Passive Income
digital_course_platform.description: Person creates and sells online courses on Udemy, Skillshare, or their own platform. Different from guru course -- focuses on skill teaching.
digital_course_platform.entry_point: Decides to create and sell an online course

stages.label: Choose course topic based on expertise
Edit, add graphics, produce final version
Get first student enrollment
stages.source: Udemy 2024 -- marketplace provides some initial traffic

digital_course_platform.reality_check: Udemy has 70M+ students but 200K+ instructors. Average course earns $100-200 total lifetime. Udemy takes 63% of organic sales. Only the top 1% earn $10K+/month. Course completion rate is 5-15%.

lawn_care_business.name: Lawn Care Business -> Clients -> Scale
lawn_care_business.description: Person starts a lawn care/landscaping business. Low startup cost, recurring revenue, seasonal in most markets.
lawn_care_business.entry_point: Decides to start a lawn care business
lawn_care_business.reality_check: Lawn care is seasonal (6-8 months in most US markets). Employee turnover is 200%+ annually. Physical toll is high. But recurring revenue and low startup cost make it one of the best first businesses.
